Massive 40-90% Off Deals in Jackson County, Michigan

Want to buy properties for 40 to 90% off? Jackson County, Michigan’s Tax Foreclosure Sale is your chance. Here’s how to get in on the deals.

Jackson County Tax Foreclosure Sale Overview

Jackson County holds its tax foreclosure sales between July and November. The county auctions properties with unpaid taxes to the highest bidder, starting at a minimum bid, often a fraction of the property’s market value. The next auction happens online on August 20th, 2024, from 10:00 am to 7:00 pm.

Bidding Methods in Jackson County Tax Sale

There are three primary ways to participate in the auctions:

  1. In-Person at the Auction: Attend the auction venue to bid directly.
  2. Online via the Website: Registered users can bid on properties through the auction website.
  3. Proxy/Absentee Bid: This option is for those unable to attend in person or bid online, allowing them to place bids in advance​.

Website Features for Registered Users

The auction website, tax-sale.info, offers various tools to assist bidders, including:

  • Photos and descriptions of properties.
  • Online pre-registration for faster check-in/out.
  • Property location details are available via GPS/GIS, maps, and Google Earth links.
  • A feature to save favorite properties for easy access.

Important Details

Here are some key details for Jackson County’s tax foreclosure sales:

Jackson County Property Review and Information Accuracy

Properties are sold “as-is,” so you must verify details independently. You have approximately 90 days, starting May 1, to explore thousands of parcels. For smoother processing, we suggest registering early on the auction website​.

Auction Pre-Registration

Pre-registering on the Michigan Public Land Auction website can save you time during the auction process. Bidding opens 30 days before the auction and continues until the auction starts.

Property Lists and Viewing Precautions

Property lists may change up to the auction day. You cannot enter properties without permission, as it is illegal. Only inspections are allowed. Properties may be occupied or monitored.

Payment Instructions for Jackson County Tax Sale Auction

For auction purchases, immediate full payment post-auction is required. No time-payment plans are allowed. Payment methods vary based on the purchase price, with certain thresholds requiring certified funds. The winning bidder will receive an email with payment details and notarization requirements​​.

FAQs

Q: What happens if I don’t pay my delinquent taxes?
A: Failing to pay your delinquent taxes within two years allows the county to foreclose on your property and sell it at a public auction.

Q: Can I get more time to pay my delinquent property taxes?
A: Yes, you can request additional time during the foreclosure hearing by applying for a hardship deferral​​.

Q: Are the properties sold in the auction guaranteed to be free of other liens?
A: No, the county sells properties “as-is,” and buyers must verify the status of any liens or encumbrances themselves.
